name: whatsapp
description: Your own WhatsApp as a linked device, a real user, not a bot (QR login only): chats, messages, groups, bans, voice calls and voice messages. Received files are saved in /home/bia/files/inbox/whatsapp/; voice notes arrive transcribed as [speech <lang>]; locations, contacts and edits arrive as [location], [live location], [contact] and [edited <id>] lines. The login is restored by itself at boot.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log into whatsapp -> discover(path='mcp/whatsapp', enable=true); whatsapp_login()  (QR opens in a WhatsApp QR window on :0)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send hi on that whatsapp chat -> whatsapp_send(chat_id='15551234567', text='hi')

alice|whatsapp:15551234567|<issued>|<delivered>|[speech en] hello -> say(identity='alice', channel='whatsapp:15551234567', message='Hi — short spoken reply.', lang='en'); wait for [you finished speaking] before speaking again
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send alice a voice message saying I am late -> whatsapp_send_voice(chat_id='15551234567', text='Hi, I am running about ten minutes late.', lang='en')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a whatsapp group Trip with +49 170 1234567 and +1 555 555 0100 -> whatsapp_create_group(title='Trip', members=['491701234567', '15555550100'])
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|only admins may write in that whatsapp group -> whatsapp_group_permissions(chat_id='120363012345678901@g.us', only_admins_send=true)
